meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文排行榜趋势，找到热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想知道现在什么题材最火，好决定写什么
copy.tagline_en: Analyze web novel rankings to find trending themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what themes are hot and decide what to write

howto.what: 它会抓取起点、番茄、晋江等平台的排行榜数据,分析题材热度与市场趋势,写出扫榜报告。接着会给出 2-3 个带可行性评估的选题建议,并保存成文件。
howto.when: 当你说“长篇什么火”等扫榜用语,或输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜 等命令时触发;接着会先确认你看哪个平台、有没有题材方向。

say.text: 扫一下起点月票榜,看看最近哪些题材最火
say.note: 抓取起点月票榜,输出题材热度报告

say.text: 我想写种田文,扫一下番茄新书榜有没有这个方向
say.note: 会针对该题材做深度扫榜

say.text: 我没方向,帮我扫个全榜看看最近什么题材火
say.note: 做全榜概览并给出趋势与选题建议

howto.what_en: Fetches ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang and more (via built-in scrapers or user-provided links/screenshots), analyzes genre trends, and outputs a scan report plus a topic-decision file with 2-3 feasible story ideas.
howto.when_en: When you say phrases like "长篇什么火" or use commands like /story-long-scan or /长篇扫榜. It then asks which platform and genre direction you want.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly ticket ranking and tell me which genres are hot.
say_en.note: Fetches the ranking and outputs a genre-hotness report.

say_en.text: I plan a farming story; scan Fanqie's new-book list for that trend.
say_en.note: Runs a deep scan on that genre.

say_en.text: No direction in mind; scan the boards and find current hot genres.
say_en.note: Gives an overview and suggests story directions.
